concept: Carbon — night-tech audio, wearables, and EDC carry. Dark, precision-engineered aesthetic matching the Carbon preset's near-black UI (#0B0B0B bg, volt-green accent).

collections.title: Audio
collections.description: Headphones, buds, and speakers tuned for the commute and the desk.

collections.title: Wearables
collections.description: Watches built for battery life over gimmicks.

collections.title: Carry & Tech
collections.description: Power, cable, and carry for whatever's already in your pockets.

products.title: Pulse Buds Pro
products.desc: Active noise cancelling in a case small enough to forget. Sealed drivers cut commute noise without the usual bass loss, and the case holds four extra charges for multi-day trips.

products.title: Monitor-X Headphones
products.desc: Studio-tuned drivers with adaptive ANC that recalibrates every ten minutes to the room you're in. Fifty hours of playback means one charge a week, not one a day.

products.title: Signal Speaker 03
products.desc: Full-range sound from a housing rated for rain, dust, and the occasional drop off a ledge. Pair two for stereo separation across a room.

products.title: Nightwatch Pro
products.desc: Always-on AMOLED that stays legible in direct sun, GPS that locks in under five seconds, and enough battery to survive a weekend without a charger in sight.

products.title: Nightwatch Lite
products.desc: The essentials without the always-on drain: sleep staging, heart rate, and a battery that lasts the week instead of the day.

products.title: Power Cell 20K
products.desc: Enough capacity for a laptop and two phones on one trip, with 65W PD fast enough to top up a notebook between meetings.

products.title: Power Cell 10K Mini
products.desc: Half the size of a standard bank, still good for two full phone charges. The one that actually stays in your pocket instead of the drawer.

products.title: Tech Sling 3L
products.desc: A padded sling built around the shape of a phone, a bank, and a set of buds — not a generic bag that happens to fit tech.

products.title: Cable Roll Kit
products.desc: Four braided cables and a compact wall plug in a roll that stops them from turning into a knot at the bottom of a bag.

products.title: Lens Case Hard
products.desc: A hard shell with custom foam cutouts that keeps a lens or a compact rig from shifting in transit.

products.title: Phone Harness
products.desc: Chest-mounted carry with a quick-release buckle, built for hands-free filming or navigation on the move.

products.title: Wireless Charge Pad
products.desc: 15W fast wireless charging on a pad slim enough to leave on a nightstand without it looking like a gadget.

products.title: Signal Beanie
products.desc: Conductive threads at the fingertips mean the phone works without the beanie coming off first.

products.title: Grid Gloves
products.desc: Thermal lining for cold mornings, touchscreen fingertips so the gloves never have to come off at the crosswalk.

products.title: Transit Pouch
products.desc: A water-resistant zip pouch sized for a bank, a cable roll, and whatever else lives in the bottom of a bag.
